The '''Catchhawks''' was a team of individuals working for [[Space Rescue Corps/Legends|New Republic Search and Rescue Corps]]. Led by [[Uldir Lochett]], he and his crew used the ship ''[[No Luck Required]]'' during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
